statement: The unchanged live MovieLens affinity scenario passes three consecutive fresh runs with a runtime-owner-published result-to-partial snapshot witness that remains valid while later periodic partial snapshots continue.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not widen convergence or stall timeouts, weaken freshness, identity, boundedness, placement, or exact-result checks, or relabel the existing live scenario.
Before another live run, reproduce the result/partial chronology failure deterministically through the production parallel-reduce runtime and real SQLite, then prove the correction red-on-revert.
The runtime owner must publish the result-to-partial snapshot witness; the demo observer may validate that witness but must not infer it from polling cadence or relax it to result equality alone.
